rules.title: San Diego Tenant Protection Ordinance - Buyout Agreement Requirements
rules.requirement: If a landlord offers a tenant money to leave voluntarily, the landlord must give specific written disclosures, follow strict formatting and content rules for any buyout agreement, and the agreement is void if it offers less than required relocation assistance or attempts to waive tenant rights.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental properties in San Diego subject to the Tenant Protection Ordinance (Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7 of the San Diego Municipal Code).
rules.citation: San Diego Mun. Code ch. 9, art. 8, div. 7 (§ 98.0706)
rules.quoted_span: Buyout agreements for amounts less than the amount of relocation assistance available to Tenant is void. Buyout agreements which attempt to waive or limit a Tenant's rights under this Ordinance are contrary to public policy and void.
rules.conflict_note: Chunk does not state whether the Ordinance applies retroactively to unadjudicated termination notices predating the effective period.
